preregistration.name: Proxima Milestone 8 frozen-detector frequency confirmation
preregistration.scientific_target: A narrowband transmitter stable in the planet frame and not necessarily aimed at Earth
preregistration.selection_rule: Two previously unsearched 0.5 MHz planet-frame intervals, 1405.25-1405.75 and 1423.25-1423.75 MHz, were fixed before extracting or inspecting these frequencies. Both lie inside the 1400-1427 MHz passive allocation, outside the H I line region, and at least 1 MHz from every Milestone 7 interval.
preregistration.confirmation_scope: Independent in frequency but not in observing epoch: the same three Proxima ON/OFF visits are used at untouched frequencies.
preregistration.method_note: The final Milestone 7 recurrence statistic, S/N floor, moving per-epoch RFI mask, spectral widths, candidate clustering, and family flags are copied without adjustment. Only the predeclared confirmation bands, random seeds, and extended completeness grid differ.
preregistration.prior_data_contact: These source filterbanks were used at other frequencies, but neither confirmation interval was searched or candidate-inspected before this preregistration.

global_result.assessment: NO CANDIDATE: every ON maximum is below the calibrated operational threshold.

completeness.method: Real m8_1405p5 planet-frame noise vectors are independently circularly shifted by epoch; signals use time-averaged sinc-squared leakage and model acceleration within each integration.
completeness.ideal_snr_definition: Single-epoch S/N the same total signal power would produce as a stationary bin-centred one-channel tone.

interpretation_limits: This search covers 2 disjoint planet-frame bands totaling 1 MHz, not the full receiver band.
A null result constrains only signals present in at least two of the three epochs and represented by the orbital template bank.
The 1/3/5/9-channel boxcars approximate, but do not exactly match, every fractional-bin and acceleration-smeared line shape.
Completeness is measured for exact orbital-bank templates active in epochs 1 and 3; it is not yet marginalized over orbital-model error or every duty cycle.
When configured, the recurrence guard requires every claimed active epoch to exceed its stated single-epoch S/N floor.
Confirmation scope: Independent in frequency but not in observing epoch: the same three Proxima ON/OFF visits are used at untouched frequencies.
The per-epoch RFI mask follows each circularly shifted epoch in the empirical null and completeness trials.
Scramble p-values are empirical ranks with resolution 1/(N+1), not Gaussian sigma conversions.
